However, required replacement is not complete: same-pattern evidence still finds the arbitrary `{description,prompt}` Agent path and lifecycle owners in `src/reviewer-role.ts`, `src/reviewer-agent.ts`, and `src/reviewer-execution-ledger.ts`. Therefore opaque-runner enforcement, append-only projection integration, actual-dispatch equality, mandatory CLI transport, fixture removal, and end-to-end package behavior are not established. Reporting `completed` would contradict the authority and current repository facts.
